environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALBv2 with AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached. The WebACL includes three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING action override set to COUNT (not BLOCK), (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in default BLOCK mode, and (3) a custom rule group 'corp-sqli-deep-inspection' with a RegexPatternSet matching on query string parameters using pattern `(?i)(?:union[\s/\*]+select|'\s*(?:or|and)\s+['\'\d]|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|information_schema|extractvalue|updatexml|benchmark\s*\()` with BLOCK action and priority 0 (highest). CloudWatch metrics confirm the custom rule fires on UNION-based and boolean-based injection patterns in query strings. The ALB access logs show the WAF evaluation occurs before the request reaches the target group.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALBv2 with WAFv2 WebACL association
